guide:
## Welcome

This page lets you edit the Oromo Resource Centre website yourself — text, photos, prayer times, events — with no coding. Changes you publish here go live on oromorc.org within about a minute.

## How to edit anything

1. On the left, click the section you want to change (for example "Donate Page").
2. Click into the item, change the text, number, or photo.
3. Click the green **Publish** button at the top right. That's it — it's live.

## Where to find things

- **About Section (Home Page)** — the "About" text block on the homepage.
- **Contact Page** — the "Get In Touch" section on the homepage (address, emergency phone, Saturday school hours, quick contact card).
- **Donate Page** — everything on oromorc.org/donate: bank transfer details, tax info, impact text.
- **Funeral Services Page** — everything on the Janaza / funeral service page.
- **Footer** — the green bar at the bottom of every page: address, phone, Quick Links, Saturday School note.
- **Upcoming Events** — event cards on the homepage AND on the mosque TV screen. Add a new event when something's coming up; delete it once it's passed.
- **Azan Display (TV Screen)** — everything on the mosque's TV screen at oromorc.org/azan: prayer time settings, the dark screen during prayer, the "Respond to the Azan" and "Du'aa After Azan" screens, the donation panel.
- **After Prayer Dhikr** — the Arabic du'as that rotate on the TV screen after each prayer.
- **Gallery Photos** — photos shown on the Gallery page.
- **Site Translations** — the English and Afaan Oromoo text used in menus, buttons, and headings everywhere. This one is more technical — editing the wrong line can make text disappear from a button or heading. If you're not sure, it's safest to leave this section alone.

## Uploading a photo

When you see a field that shows an image, click it — you can drag a photo in or pick one you've already uploaded before.

## If something looks wrong after publishing

Give it 30–60 seconds, then refresh the page on the real website. If it's still wrong, come back here and change the field back to what it was before — nothing is permanently lost.

## Something you need isn't here

Ask Claude (the assistant that built this site) to add a new editable field for it.
